Claim 15 (Currently amended): The method of selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising: receiving a request from the client computer; accessing a first server computer and a second server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, wherein the second server computer is a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The system for selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising: a first server computer; a second server computer; and a media request broker, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature; circuitry for accessing the first server computer and the second server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; circuitry for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer; and circuitry for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The computer program product for selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising: a computer-readable medium having program code thereon for receiving a request from the client computer; program code for accessing a first server computer and a second server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; program code for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer; program code for the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and program code for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, wherein the second server computer is a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature.
